{{Top|leg}}
'''Muja Bandits''' were a group of notorious bandits, who previously desecrated revered [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] temples. One became a member of the [[Izvoshra/Legends|Izvoshra]] under the leadership of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Lord">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref>
